expo.name: iYiYi
expo.description: Meet people within 150ft. Discover nearby users, share content, and connect with your local community in real-time.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: iYiYi uses your location to show you people within 150ft.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: iYiYi needs access to your photos to set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: iYiYi uses the camera so you can capture moments and tag the people around you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: iYiYi uses the microphone to record sound in your videos and for voice in video calls.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: iYiYi saves the photos and videos you shoot to an iYiYi album.
